dedupe_keys.name: meteor nepal flood hazard map pluvial for return periods of 1 in 5 10 20 50 75 100 200 250 500 and 1000 years

description: SSBN Ltd (Fathom) publishes national pluvial flood-depth maps for Nepal through the METEOR project. Zenodo lists nine public GeoTIFF layers under ODbL 1.0, with WGS84 coordinates and a stated 3-arcsecond, roughly 90 m grid. The files show modelled maximum water depth in metres for return periods from 1-in-5 to 1-in-1000 years. Fathom describes a two-dimensional shallow-water model using MERIT elevation and hydrography. The maps can place roads, substations or hospitals in rainfall-flood exposure and resilience scenarios. A related catalogue METEOR Nepal record covers landslide maps, not these pluvial depths. A limitation is that the title names a 1-in-250-year layer but the public file inventory omits it. The provider also warns against detailed local engineering use because global inputs and simplified processes limit accuracy. Return-period maps are separate event maxima, not a simultaneous national flood. No raster was downloaded or independently tested.
